full_page.content:
c. 1929
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 3.
Pg. 41. 1929 Immaculate Conception - Retreat 4 Days
I. Miserere mei Deus Cor mumdum crea in me. Spiritu principali confirmo me.
II. Deus Dominator -- Princeps pacis -- His slave of necessity - love or justice. What privilege! Fr. Barrolorme Dec. 1300 son of rich man who planned and planned to have him wed at 24 he flees the world & its danger. Becomes lay-brother- Priest - Serves 20 yrs. poor lepers; At Mass his hand pain fearfully. Next day they are black with leprosy. He goes to Altar and sings "Te Deum"
III. Death " I positively must die. When? Where? How ?!?!
IV. Malice of Sin - Calvary Before the time - "Calvary after the time." The Crib before, the Altar after - Aye in Shadow of +
V. Reparation - Where and Now or - & Then. Reparation of love here-or-of Justice there.
VI. Chastity - Sacrifice - of the a) Will, b) Imagination - the heart
VII. Happiness of Religious - a) Impossible i. e. its dryness of necessity, but nevertheless possible. c) Not only its possibility, but its superiority, its excelency-supremacy.
IX. Diviciae Meae Christus - St. Louis of Tombs.
Pg. 42. X. Mary after Jesus Our salvation What does Jesus owe Mary? What does Mary owe Jesus? What do I owe Mary - and Jesus ???
